items.title: TTD Stock Sinks Over 26% On Earnings Miss, Weak Outlook — Retail Says Trade Desk’s Guidance Is The Real Problem
items.summary: The ad-tech company missed revenue and earnings expectations, while a weaker forecast overshadowed strong customer retention and sent shares sharply lower after hours.

items.title: Trade Desk Stock Slumps After Revenue Misses Forecasts
items.summary: Shares of  Trade Desk  slumped 24% in after hours trading after the advertising technology company reported second quarter revenue that fell short of expectations.  The company reported adjusted earnings of 34 cents a share and revenue of $715 million, up 3% from a year ago.  Analysts tracked by FactSet expected adjusted earnings of 18 cents a share and revenue of $752.6 million.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Aug. 6: Trade Desk Plummets After Hours on Weak Q2 Results
items.summary: Shares tumbled following the programmatic ad platform's earnings report, with revenue, earnings, and guidance falling well short of Wall Street's hopes, today, Aug. 6, 2026.

items.title: The Trade Desk (NASDAQ:TTD) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q2 CY2026 Earnings, Stock Drops 21.8%
items.summary: Digital advertising platform The Trade Desk (NASDAQ:TTD) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026 as sales rose 3% year on year to $715.1 million. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $650 million underwhelmed, coming in 19.2% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.34 per share was 15.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Trade Desk shares sink on Q2 revenue miss and weak guidance
items.summary: Investing.com -- The Trade Desk Inc. reported second-quarter earnings per share of $0.34, beating analyst estimates of $0.18. Revenue stood at $715 million, significantly below the consensus estimate of $752.61 million.
